spanish: y piedras de shóham y piedras de engastes al efod y al joshen.

findings.issue: שֹׁהַם is a common noun (masculine singular absolute), not a proper name. shóham leaves the lemma untranslated.
אֵפוֹד is a common noun (masculine singular absolute), not a proper name. efod leaves the lemma untranslated.
חֹשֶׁן is a common noun (masculine singular absolute), not a proper name. joshen leaves the lemma untranslated.

notes: piedras de … y piedras de match the two construct chains; al and y al match the two definite lameds.
